statements.status_notes: CVE-2024-32866 is a prototype-pollution flaw in the parseWith* helpers of @conform-to/{dom,zod} <1.1.1. The fix landed alongside @conform-to's v1.0.0 API rewrite, which removed the `parse` export that trigger.dev's webapp imports across its admin routes (apps/webapp/app/routes/_app.orgs.* and resources.orgs.*); bumping to 1.1.1 breaks the webapp build (verified empirically with esbuild reporting `No matching export in @conform-to/zod for import 'parse'`). Reachability assessment is pending: the affected parseWith* calls run only after Remix's authenticated `_app.*` layout, so an unauthenticated network adversary cannot reach them, but an authenticated org member can supply form input to those routes. Tracking upstream Trigger.dev's migration to @conform-to v1.x; will revisit once that lands.
